groups.source_quote: HUMA/SOSC | Heritage and Cultural Sustainability Electives (3 courses, which should include two courses at 3000-level or above, from the specified elective list. Courses taken as Major Elective Courses may not be counted towards this elective requirement.) | 9

caveats: SHSS 4991 OR SHSS 4992 OR (SHSS 4991 AND SHSS 4993) -- [For students taking one of the Research Options, they should take SHSS 4992 OR (SHSS 4991 AND SHSS 4993)]

Students in the Integrated Humanities and Social Science Track with CGA of 3.3 or above may apply for enrollment in the Heritage and Cultural Sustainability Research Option. In addition, they should take Honors Thesis or Honors Research with a primary focus in heritage and cultural sustainability to complete the requirement of SHSS 4992 OR (SHSS 4991 AND SHSS 4993) as specified in the major requirements.
SOSC 4290: The course was last offered in 2023-24 and was deleted subsequently.
